finding: A locally generated LINE in additional paper space was present in R12/R14 ASCII and binary output; ezdxf 1.4.5 audit removed the orphaned block and the line while the exporter reported no loss.
fix: Before touching the destination, refuse legacy output when additional paper blocks contain modeled children, nondefault metadata or modeled INSERT references. A plain R12 uppercased paper block is matched to the kernel default on import.
validation: macOS ARM64: 71 DXF round-trip/export tests and six layout graph tests passed
Four legacy targets refused additional paper content without overwriting destination; removing the offending content allowed retry
The same DXFimpl writer object refused then successfully retried after correction
The primary paper-space LINE survived R12 reopen and independent ezdxf audit
Focused controls refuse a referenced empty block and a block with nonzero base
Older bundled codec headers passed syntax compilation; linked runtime qualification remains open
Locally generated R12 with nonzero additional-paper base and LINE retains both on import and refuses unsafe export without touching destination, including a versionless-header control.
Locally authored R14 cases preserve nonzero block base, children and both anonymous states, and refuse unsafe output without overwriting the destination.

After sharing case-folding, the 71 DXF round-trip/export and six layout tests passed; the application built with the later Save As filename rollback. The GUI refusal observation predates that filename change.
limitations: The empty orphan block still incurs an ezdxf audit repair; distinguish application-created and imported blocks and qualify references before removing it.
Additional nondefault source metadata, binary layout replay and broader producer/consumer behavior remain unqualified.
Native final-head and hosted Linux/Windows checks remain open.

import_followup.finding: Before the follow-up, uppercased nondefault source paper was stored outside the kernel default lookup, so export succeeded and dropped its LINE.
import_followup.result: The import now replaces the matching default using the source base/anonymous state and canonical block name; the source LINE remains reachable and legacy export refuses.

r14_import_followup.finding: Before the follow-up a nonzero source base was replaced by the application default.
r14_import_followup.result: Imported R14 source base, modeled anonymous state, and LINE remain available to the legacy guard.

native_refusal_dialog.result: Fresh isolated app process opened the source, confirmed the save action owned that source, refused an R12 save, displayed the paper-space explanation and R2000 recommendation, and created no destination file.
native_refusal_dialog.limits: The proof app contains scratch-only title and save-owner instrumentation; it is not the final packaged UI. Rendering/editing and other platforms remain open.

native_save_state_rollback.result: In a fresh isolated process, an R12 Save As was refused with its specific reason and no output file. A scratch-only post-save observation showed the original source filename was retained.
native_save_state_rollback.limits: App contains scratch-only title and post-save state instrumentation; this is not final packaged UI or other-platform qualification.
